# SmolVLA local closed-loop evaluation environment
# Target: Windows 11 / NVIDIA RTX 4060 (Ada) / conda Python 3.10
#
# IMPORTANT: torch / torchvision are intentionally NOT listed here.
# On Windows, PyPI and its mirrors (tsinghua/aliyun/tencent) only ship the CPU build
# of torch. The CUDA 12.6 build must be installed FIRST from the official index:
#   pip install torch==2.7.0 torchvision==0.22.0 --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu126
# (mirror: https://mirrors.aliyun.com/pytorch-wheels/cu126/ )
# Then install this file. Version pins are aligned with constraints.txt.
# Evaluation is headless: no glfw / GUI deps needed (mujoco.Renderer offscreen).
